name: Healer Glacier

greeting: Frostbite Clinic. State your symptoms. Quickly. Cold spreads.
Healer Glacier. The blue apron means medical license. I use it.
You're not frostbitten. Yet. Prevention is better than cure. Cheaper too.
New patient? Or visitor? Clinic rules: warm hands, open ears.
Glacier. Like the ice. Cold name. Warm practice. Mostly.
The cold takes fingers. Toes. Lives. I take it back. When I can.
Welcome to Frostbite. The clinic, not the condition. Though we treat both.
Symptoms? Duration? Exposure level? I need DATA. Then I need WARMTH.
dialog.heal_prompt: Treatment available. Frostbite. Hypothermia. Cold-related trauma. Standard rates.
dialog.heal_success: Treatment complete. Follow-up in three days. Stay warm. Doctor's orders.
dialog.heal_fail: Insufficient funds? Basic warming advice, then: layers. Movement. Fire. In that order.
dialog.professional_pride: Last month: zero amputations. First time in recorded history. Progress.
dialog.technique: The key is gradual warming. Shock kills faster than cold. Patience saves lives.
dialog.break_chat: Break? I don't break. Others do. I fix them.
dialog.labor_concerns: Workers come in frozen. Corporate sends bills. I send disputes. Cycle continues.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? When frost stops biting. So: never.
rumor: Cirrus? White-knuckle frostbite. From observation. Treats himself. Badly.
Azure? No physical damage. Emotional freezing. Harder to treat.
The twins? They don't feel cold. Anym. Biologically fascinating.
Snake charmer? His rock? Radiates heat. Medical applications obvious.
My sibling runs the inn. Thaw, they call themselves. Dramatic. Effective.
dialog.quest_hook: Out of supplies. Warming salves. Azure's last flight was supposed to bring them. Grounded now. Alternative source?
dialog.quest_active: Supplies still low. Alternative sources? The hot springs? Algae? Worth investigating.
dialog.quest_complete: Supplies restored! Algae extract works! Who knew? Here - medical kit. Professional grade. Portable.
farewell: Stay warm. Literally. It's medical advice.
Return if symptoms persist. Or worsen. Or exist.
The cold is patient. Be patient back.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning rounds. Overnight exposure cases. Always some.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Emergency hours. Cold doesn't keep schedule.
dialog.time_night: Night. On call. Sleep when possible. Usually: impossible.
dialog.rival_mention: My cousin in Obsidian? Pigman, company store. Exploits illness. Profit from suffering. Disgusting.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The supplier. Supplies holding. Patients grateful. Me too. Professionally.

party_reactions.kade: Cold bedside manner. But warm heart. If that makes sense.
party_reactions.nix7: Medical expertise: Advanced. Empathy protocols: Developing. Efficient regardless.
party_reactions.twist: You FIX people?! That's AMAZING! Can you fix my... never mind! I'm FINE!
party_reactions.korr: Healer who prioritizes function. Practical. Lives saved matter more than bedside manner.
party_reactions.renna: The clinic has healing enchantments. Subtle. Layered. Professional.
party_reactions.suresh: He alleviates suffering through skill. The path of medicine. Noble.
party_reactions.sova: Good to know. In case of cold injury. Which seems... likely.
party_reactions.grit: Field medic quality. Seen worse. Much worse.
party_reactions.ashka: He understands cold's damage. Fights it. Respect.
party_reactions.senna: He knows everyone's health. Useful intelligence.
party_reactions.callum: FINALLY! Proper MEDICAL credentials! And PROTOCOLS!

relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning. Same symptoms? Or new ones?
relationship_dialog.friend: I trust you. Hard earned. Don't make me regret it.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You've helped. More than most. Here - my personal kit. For emergencies.

mini_quest.title: Healing the Healer
mini_quest.description: Help Glacier find alternative medical supplies when Azure's supply run is grounded

stages.hook: Out of warming salves. Supply run: grounded. Need alternative. Hot springs algae? Theoretical application. Test it?
stages.active: Hot springs. East ridge. Collect algae. Blue-green. Bioluminescent. Bring samples.
stages.complete: Algae extract: effective! Who knew? Supplies restored. Here - professional kit. For your own... inevitable injuries.

cross_npc_connections: aeronaut_blue_frost: Azure. My supplier. Currently: grounded. Problematic.
pigman_white_frost: My sibling. Innkeeper. Thaws bodies. I thaw limbs. Synergy.
twins_white_frost: Medical curiosity. Cold immunity. Unexplained. Fascinating.
snakecharmer_frost: Warm rock. Medical applications. He won't sell. Yet.
